name: smwmusic-celeste-golden-ridge-golden-feather-mix
title: Celeste - Golden Ridge (Golden Feather Mix)
description:
A bittersweet chiptune track. This is my favorite song from Celeste.

By In Love With A Ghost.

This port was made for a level where the wind (channel #5) would be silenced and unsilenced with asm - I don't have the code for this, but if you reimplement it yourself it should work. You can also turn the wind off entirely by using the define.
